correctness.rationale: For all smooth parameters the reciprocal quartic discriminant is nonzero and f has nine simple roots; the resulting genus is four. Symbolic expansion of f^3 provides a 4x4 Cartier–Manin matrix which permutes to two rank-one-or-two blocks, each with determinant P. This proves the exact a-number classification over the algebraic closure. The independent direct 49-case coefficient enumeration checks 31 smooth pairs, precisely two rank-2 cases, and square-zero Cartier matrices at those cases; p-rank follows from stable semilinear rank.

value.rationale: The explicit hypersurface is a complete and geometrically motivated nonordinary stratum in a natural genus-four dihedral automorphism family, extending the prior focus on the much rarer superspecial locus. The characteristic-seven classification includes a precise 31-smooth-model cutoff and two geometric a=2, arithmetic p-rank-zero models, giving an exact input to the study of positive-characteristic Jacobian stratification rather than arbitrary isolated parameter arithmetic.
